content.title: Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals announces 1-for-15 reverse stock split
content.summary: Cyclacel Pharmaceuticals (CYCC) announced that it expects to implement a 1-for-15 reverse stock split on its shares of common stock effective July 7, 2025, with trading to begin on a split-adjusted basis at the market open on that day. Trading in the shares of common stock will continue on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbol “CYCC”.
